retrieved.title: Ticketing System says it can't find the data
retrieved.description: [TCK-97277] Flagged during routine checks: Ticketing System shows an error mentioning a broken connection to where the data is kept, and no records load at all. Please confirm root cause and next steps.
retrieved.resolution: Diagnosed a dropped connection between Ticketing System and catalog_pg caused by a credentials rotation; updated the stored connection string and confirmed Ticketing System could load data again.

retrieved.title: Login broken on Ticketing System
retrieved.description: [TCK-25362] Reported by the Ahmedabad Office team: no user can log in to Ticketing System; the login page accepts credentials then redirects back to itself. Please investigate and resolve.
retrieved.resolution: The Ticketing System session cookie domain was misconfigured after a deploy; corrected the cookie settings and cleared the CDN cache to fix login.

retrieved.title: Ticketing System says it can't find the data
retrieved.description: [TCK-90973] Flagged during routine checks: Ticketing System shows an error mentioning a broken connection to where the data is kept, and no records load at all. Please confirm root cause and next steps.
retrieved.resolution: Diagnosed a dropped connection between Ticketing System and catalog_pg caused by a credentials rotation; updated the stored connection string and confirmed Ticketing System could load data again.

retrieved.title: Can't pull up records in Ticketing System
retrieved.description: [TCK-73422] Flagged during routine checks: trying to view customer or order records in Ticketing System just spins and then shows an error saying it cannot reach the records system. Please confirm root cause and next steps.
retrieved.resolution: The application server's connection pool to orders_pg had exhausted; restarted the pooler and verified Ticketing System could reach orders_pg again, restoring record lookups.

retrieved.title: Can't pull up records in Ticketing System
retrieved.description: [TCK-30880] Support desk logged the following: trying to view customer or order records in Ticketing System just spins and then shows an error saying it cannot reach the records system. Awaiting assignment to the right team.
retrieved.resolution: The application server's connection pool to inventory_pg had exhausted; restarted the pooler and verified Ticketing System could reach inventory_pg again, restoring record lookups.
